description: This file defines a PHP interface 'LiveGenerator' within the namespace 'Todaymade\Daux\Format\Base'. The interface extends another interface 'Generator' and declares a method 'generateOne' that takes an 'Entry' object and a 'Config' object, and returns a 'Page' object.

classes.name: LiveGenerator
classes.description: An interface for generating live content, extending the 'Generator' interface, with a method 'generateOne' for creating a page from a tree node with configuration.

methods.name: generateOne
methods.description: Creates a single Page object from the provided Tree Entry node and configuration.
